'''Fumiko Takekuma''' (Japanese: '''武隈史子''' ''Takekuma Fumiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Takekuma was born on February 23, 1980 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Her best known roles in the {{pkmn|animated series}} were {{an|Sophocles}}, one of {{ashcl|Ash's classmates}}; [[James's Mareanie]]; and [[Kiawe's Marowak]]; all of these roles were in {{aniseries|SM}}.
